biography.value: A Storm Sovereign's Aura displaces enemies constantly. A typical turn spends two actions on Gale Fist against whoever Storm Sovereign Aura failed to clear and a third on Tempest Bolt against anything trying to engage from range — three actions, the third at MAP but still at Ranged Combat 7 and Agil 8, which makes that penalty manageable. Lightning Immunity Sharing is a notable battlefield benefit — a summoner who builds their party around a Storm Sovereign can deny an entire damage type to grouped enemies without any additional resource cost. Clear target priority is the only instruction it strictly requires; the Sovereign determines execution from there.

system.attacksNotes:
Gale Fist [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 14 damage (8 + 6 Str) + 4 lightning damage (Half DR); target pushed 20 feet and knocked Prone; no save.
  • Margin 2: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 lightning damage; Prone + Stunned until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 3: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 lightning damage + Stunned; all creatures within 10 feet of target take 8 lightning damage from the discharge.

Tempest Bolt [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 180 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 18 lightning damage (15 + 3 Dex) + Dazed until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 2: 18 lightning damage, DR halved (round up) + Stunned + Dazed for 1 minute.
  • Margin 3: 18 lightning damage, DR halved (round up) + Stunned + Dazed + Deafened for 1 minute; Fortitude [Hard] save to reduce Deafened to 1 round only.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Storm Sovereign Aura: Creatures within 20 feet that are not designated must make a Fortitude [Hard] save at the start of their turn. Failure: pushed 15 feet and Deafened for 1 round. The summoner and designated allies are immune. Lightning Immunity Sharing: The summoner and up to 4 designated allies gain immunity to non-magical lightning damage while within 60 feet. Eye of the Storm: The Storm Sovereign designates up to 6 creatures within 30 feet as protected. Protected creatures are immune to Storm Sovereign Aura and cannot be pushed or knocked Prone by any of the Storm Sovereign’s ### Attacks or abilities. Designation changes as a [Free] action. Momentum Defense: While the Storm Sovereign has moved at least half its fly speed this turn, ### Attacks against it add 1 to both attack dice. Resilient Defense (3/day): When the Storm Sovereign fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
